title: The Painted Autopsy
author: August Nystrom
blurb: Casper Sterling, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
